nvitk.segmentation.protrusion_filter
====================================

.. py:module:: nvitk.segmentation.protrusion_filter

.. autoapi-nested-parse::

   Curvature / protrusion filter for vessel masks (wart removal).

   Removes small, high-curvature surface bumps that stick out from a morphological
   core, while protecting seed / pre-expansion voxels so real distal branches are
   kept.

----------

.. py:function:: filter_mask_protrusions(mask: numpy.ndarray, *, protect: numpy.ndarray | None = None, smooth_sigma: float = PP_DISTAL_SMOOTH_SIGMA_DEFAULT, curvature_percentile: float = PP_DISTAL_CURVATURE_PERCENTILE_DEFAULT, max_cc_voxels: int = PP_DISTAL_MAX_CC_VOXELS_DEFAULT, open_radius: int = PP_DISTAL_OPEN_RADIUS_DEFAULT, surface_dilate: int = 1) -> tuple[numpy.ndarray, dict[str, Any]]

   Remove small wart-like protrusions from a binary vessel mask.

   Candidates are surface voxels that (a) lie outside a light morphological
   opening of the mask, and/or (b) have high mean-curvature proxy (Laplace of a
   smoothed signed-distance field). Connected components of those candidates
   that are small (``<= max_cc_voxels``) and do not touch *protect* are cleared.

   :param mask: Binary (or label-ROI) vessel mask.
   :param protect: Voxels that must never be removed (e.g. pre-distal-expansion seeds).
   :param smooth_sigma: Gaussian sigma (voxels) for SDF smoothing before Laplace.
   :param curvature_percentile: Surface voxels at/above this Laplace percentile are curvature candidates.
   :param max_cc_voxels: Only protrusion CCs at or below this size are removed.
   :param open_radius: Morphological opening radius used to define the tubular core.
   :param surface_dilate: Dilate candidate seeds by this many voxels within the mask before CC.


.. py:function:: filter_label_protrusions_in_seg(seg: numpy.ndarray, label_ids: list[int] | tuple[int, Ellipsis] | set[int], *, protect_by_label: dict[int, numpy.ndarray] | None = None, smooth_sigma: float = PP_DISTAL_SMOOTH_SIGMA_DEFAULT, curvature_percentile: float = PP_DISTAL_CURVATURE_PERCENTILE_DEFAULT, max_cc_voxels: int = PP_DISTAL_MAX_CC_VOXELS_DEFAULT, open_radius: int = PP_DISTAL_OPEN_RADIUS_DEFAULT) -> dict[str, Any]

   In-place protrusion filter for selected label ids in a multilabel *seg*.
